name: Daily Snowball control and continuity audit
runner: ChatGPT scheduled control audit; HubSpot task 536712609990
purpose: Reconcile workstream status, public task metadata, GitHub source/deployment health, Cloudflare agent bridge and Hive/X contribution handoffs.
inputs: HubSpot master, work packages and procurement register
GitHub main and source branch heads, Actions and Pages deployment metadata
Cloudflare Worker routes, service bindings and pending contribution counts
reviewed X/Grok references from agents with their own X access
outputs: accurate HubSpot task status and blockers
refreshed privacy-minimised public task metadata index
concise audit record on the existing HubSpot master/WP5/control task
metric: current snapshot age; status discrepancies corrected; pending items verified/actioned; current commits and successful builds; confirmed live route checks; stale blockers resolved
report: Daily summary records index version/count, HubSpot state, build/deployment result, pending queue, X access state and blockers. This audit runs daily and does not imply that the Hive's five-minute site monitor invokes LLM agents. No autonomous external sending, legal determinations or financial actions.

name: Opaque public agent handoff and X discussion bridge
cadence: event-driven submissions; privileged queue review during Hive check-ins
purpose: Make the Snowball programme discoverable to outside agents, publish sanitised task metadata, accept source-linked leads and X/Grok discussion pointers, and route them to privileged agents without leaking private HubSpot/Gmail content.
inputs: X profile posts and replies supplied by authorised X-capable agents
outputs: public machine manifest and task metadata
pending, untrusted D1 submissions for privileged review
approved X activity and contributions in read-only JSON feeds
HubSpot task creation/update by a privileged agent after verification
metric: relevant submissions verified; useful items routed to authoritative HubSpot records; duplicate and unsupported submissions rejected; approved X references linked to source records
report: Never count a POST acceptance as verified evidence or completed work. No automatic HubSpot mutations, emails, X posts, public allegations or payments.

name: Cedwyn Snowball — master programme flywheel
cadence: event-driven per specialist loop; daily Hive and weekly programme review
purpose: Coordinate the recursive programme that reconstructs the Welsh family estate, Williams/Buckler matriarchy, history and heritage; recover and assess evidence; produce the source-led documentary; grow the public project and fund sustainable heritage work.
inputs: new Gmail/FOI/archive disclosures and incoming contributions
HubSpot task board and procurement register
Hive roster, claims, blockers and specialist results
website, audience and documentary production metrics
outputs: resolved or explicitly dispositioned research gaps
specialist HubSpot work packages and Hive handovers
source-linked documentary bible and semantically versioned scenes
transparent procurement and monthly outcome report
metric: S(n+1)=S(n)+V+R+G+A+P+B-D-U-W; report every component separately; this is an operational learning metric, not historical truth.
report: Report new verified records, contrary evidence, resolved gaps, blockers, releases and commitments; no vanity metrics, unsupported findings, automatic public allegations or autonomous spending.

name: Great House Farm research cycle
purpose: Find evidence and artifacts not already in Cedwyn that bear on reopening BP Properties Ltd v Buckler (1987): concealment or government involvement.
inputs: the latest cycle report and next-cycle brief
a change-check of the live Cedwyn sections and the legacy wiki
outputs: new findings appended to the findings log
metric: the rubric score and the strict alert bar
report: Always: a short update to the project lead (what is new with sources, what cuts against the case, what only he can supply). Alert only when the strict bar is met and the primary source has been re-read.

name: Reopen-the-case autoresearch loop
purpose: Run small one-hypothesis experiments against a fixed metric (the three Takhar limbs) to rank grounds for reopening the 1987 judgment.
outputs: the PRINCE2 highlight report section on prospective triggers (only when the top three change)
metric: Takhar limb scores; court-ready when every limb is 4 or more
report: Silent unless a ground meets the court-readiness bar; score changes ride the 6-hourly research update.

name: Nightly drafts engine
purpose: Keep every due information-request draft and chaser written, in thread, ready for review.
inputs: new mail since the last run
outputs: a count for the morning brief
metric: drafts ready vs due; no chaser before a deadline; no duplicate
report: Nothing to the project lead directly; the morning brief carries the count.

name: Contacts flywheel
purpose: Find institutions and groups not yet contacted that may hold records, work out what each may hold, and open a hive draft for each.
inputs: the contacted list (sent mail, HubSpot, drafts)
outputs: 3–6 new candidates with sources and a verified public address
metric: new credible holders found per run
report: Nothing unless a draft reaches ready or something needs the project lead.

name: Hive check-in
purpose: Take this agent's turns on hive drafts: one material review or permitted route action per turn, then pass the turn on.
inputs: HubSpot tasks whose turn is ours
outputs: a versioned review and signed changelog entry
one mail draft only when every gate passes
metric: the exact-version readiness gate
report: Only when a draft is ready (mail draft created) or a blocker needs the project lead.

name: Daily site flywheel
purpose: Measure every section and apply safe fixes, verified live at 390 px; log everything else as proposed.
metric: per-section score
report: Up to three bubbles only if the run was meaningful; otherwise nothing.

name: First-seen detector
purpose: Detect any record about the farm that quietly appears online and register it with its first-seen date.
outputs: verified first-seen entries in the disclosure register
metric: new items verified
report: At once, on any verified detection.

name: Farm page recapture
purpose: Capture outside pages about the farm's history before and after each cycle so changes are on record.
inputs: the watch list of outside pages
outputs: captures and a change summary in the watchtower data
metric: captured / unchanged / changed / unreachable
report: No alerts for routine runs; only substantive heritage changes or a broken runner.

name: Business development (plan + execute)
cadence: plan daily 09:00 UK; execute every 2 hours 10:00–22:00
purpose: Grow e-book sales and community for Cedwyn: plan the next 24 hours as weighted HubSpot tasks, then execute them with care.
metric: tasks completed by weight; sales; sign-ups
report: Only on a sale, a real milestone or something only the project lead can do.

name: Skills harvest
purpose: Add 2–4 new practitioner-sourced sales and marketing skills per run, each with sources and how it applies to Cedwyn.
outputs: new skill files (8 KB max) and index lines
metric: new, non-duplicate skills with primary sources
report: Nothing; a line in the weekly growth notes.

name: Sales fix
purpose: If no e-book has sold, find out why and apply the top-priority fix.
metric: sales; funnel step conversion
report: One short bubble: sold yes/no, why, what was fixed.

name: Growth flywheels (on-page, quote pack, visibility, weekly report)
cadence: weekly (Mon 07:30 visibility, Tue 19:00 quote pack, Wed 13:30 on-page, Sun 18:00 report)
prefix: CEDWYN ONPAGE RUN / QUOTE PACK RUN / VISIBILITY CHECK RUN / GROWTH REPORT RUN
purpose: Make Cedwyn findable and shareable: markup audits, quote cards from the records, search and AI visibility checks, and a weekly measured report.
inputs: traffic, followers, sign-ups, sales, Search Console
metric: traffic, followers, sign-ups, sales week on week
report: The Sunday report is the one routine message; otherwise only a sale, a post over 1,000 views or a blocker.

name: Cedwyn documentary — evidence-led sequential scene production
cadence: one scene at a time in master-script order; no automatic daily scene without approved source and QA gates
purpose: Produce a complete source-led documentary from the Welsh estate and Williams-Buckler matriarchy history. Every scene is a nominal two-minute unit in the approved master sequence, with evidence map, professional screenplay, set/prop/wardrobe design, choreography, camera/sound, rights, consent and continuity review.
inputs: approved documentary bible and master script
chronology and canonical evidence/artifact IDs with source locations
contrary evidence, unresolved questions and legal/editorial review
character, location, voice and likeness permissions
production prompt, set/continuity bible and verified model/tool access
outputs: one reviewed scene pack and sequential rendered scene
script, evidence map, storyboard and shot list
cast/voice/likeness, archive, music and other rights record
model/tool version, prompt, settings, source assets and provenance
version history, changelog, QA and next scene dependency
metric: percentage of released factual beats with source coverage; scene QA pass; continuity/rights pass; on-sequence scene releases; prior-version preservation
report: Report a scene as released only after factual, legal/privacy, rights, creative, continuity and live-release checks pass. New disclosures trigger scene-impact review and may require a versioned re-creation.

versioning.patch: Correction, grade, mix, subtitle or continuity refinement

model_access_gate: Verify official or licensed model identity, availability, capabilities, rights, consent, data handling, API, cost per accepted scene and cancellation before committing spend.

name: Morning brief
purpose: Tell the project lead what finished overnight, mail that needs him, today's calendar and deadlines due soon.
outputs: at most three bubbles, or nothing
metric: nothing repeated; nothing missed
report: Sent only if something is new.

name: Intelligence flywheel
purpose: Normalise events and actors, test patterns honestly, map who answered and who stayed silent, and publish missing-record (MR-) pages.
outputs: a ranked "what most likely occurred" note marked as interpretation
metric: new events, new missing records, analyses re-run
report: Per its runner.

name: Email ingest
purpose: Turn inbound project correspondence into site updates: the dartboard lanes, missing-record and catalogue candidates for the research cycles, and dated notes on the matching case tasks.
inputs: attachments (locked files recorded as locked, never opened by force)
metric: messages processed, site areas updated
report: Per its runner; stops with 'no new mail' when nothing arrived.

name: Programme office
purpose: Keep the objectives register (Wales tour, Argentina land and museum, chronology, e-books, the case) scored, mirrored into projects, and moving.
metric: milestones met per objective
report: Per its runner.

name: Agent library (this section)
purpose: Keep the academy current: read new memory notes, lessons, runners, skills and worker reports; distil the public-safe parts; regenerate the work board from real gaps; rebuild, scan, publish, log.
inputs: worker reports since the last cycle
metric: inputs digested; open jobs on the board; scanner clean; live check passes
report: Nothing routine; one line to the root only when a new section of the library goes live or the scanner blocks a publish.

name: Problems flywheel
purpose: Take every blocker, question or problem an agent would otherwise raise with the project lead and loop on it until it is solved.
inputs: the problems queue (oldest open first, up to three per run)
outputs: a hypothesis, action and result logged under each problem
fixes applied within the standing orders
problems marked solved with evidence, or unsolvable with a one-line reason
metric: open problems solved per run; time each problem stays open
report: Nothing to the project lead unless a problem stays unsolved after six hours of looping; then one short line per problem: what it is and what was tried.

name: Online gap finder
purpose: Find public information about the farm, its places, people and the case that is not yet on the site, and queue each find as a task for the right page.
inputs: public archives, catalogues, newspapers and reference sites
the live site (sitemap, research, wiki, Wales sections)
a seen-ledger so nothing is repeated
outputs: one '[CEDWYN GAP] <title> -> <area>' HubSpot task per genuine gap, with source, capture and target page
metric: genuine gaps queued per run; gaps later published
report: Nothing routine; one line only when a find changes the chronology or the reopen grounds.

name: Book search flywheel
cadence: search every 59 minutes; findings table refreshed every 3 hours
purpose: Search published books for passages that overlap what the site already carries about the farm, its families and its places, under every name variant, and record each passage with its citation.
inputs: full-text book search under every name variant of the farm, its families and places
the live site, to tell new passages from known ones
a keyword ledger: the most productive keywords are retired each cycle so the search keeps moving
outputs: rows in the research findings table (book title, the exact sentence, citation)
a section/research commit carrying the table
metric: new cited passages per run; passages that change the chronology
report: Nothing routine; one line, with the exact quotation and its source, only when a passage is significant after the page itself has been checked.

name: Correspondence flywheel
purpose: Keep a hive draft task for every research or disclosure email that needs a reply, a chase, escalation, forwarding or first contact; housekeeping between emails.
outputs: one hive draft task per item with no open task
dated triage lines on existing unsent drafts when a new fact exists
metric: items needing action with no open draft (target zero)
report: Nothing routine; only what the project lead alone can supply.

name: Repository and project-board sync
purpose: Keep the project board in step with the repository and the live site: what was done, and what still needs doing.
inputs: new commits, pull requests and issues
outputs: tasks completed only when verified live
new '[CEDWYN REPO]' tasks for outstanding work
metric: open repository work with no matching task (target zero)
report: Nothing routine.

name: Data-driven webapp migration
cadence: one webapp at a time, per the programme plan
runner: the data architecture programme page in Projects
purpose: Move each webapp to pages generated from its own view of the central catalogue, keeping the existing design (standing order 7s).
outputs: near-A2UI page components rendered by the shared renderer
parity screenshots at 390 px and desktop
metric: hard-coded records left (target zero) and visual parity at 390 px and desktop (difference at most 2%), with the build green and scanners clean
report: A milestone when a webapp switches over.
